about: Replicated marker of an object in flight after a throw, written by esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessThrownRequests (bg3.exe+0x2AFA000) from a 0x28-byte throw request. Born live in shove-throw with RotationParametersComponent, drop components and the client thrown components.

evidence.says: esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50, line 321) copies esv::thrown::EntityThrownRequestOneFrameComponent +0xC here, which InitializeProjectileThrown fills with eoc::PathMover::SampleDuration of the projectile path (flight time). Live 0.33 .. 1.31.

ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50, line 322) copies the request byte +0x10, which InitializeProjectileThrown (EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80) takes from eoc::SpellPrototype +0x19 = Script Extender's SpellPrototype.SpellAnimationType. Live 3.

ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50, line 323) copies the request handle +0x18, which InitializeProjectileThrown (EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80) takes from InitializationInfo +0x70 = Script Extender's esv::projectile::InitializationData.Caster.
